query:
SELECT a.id, a.created_at
            FROM assets a
            JOIN originals o ON o.id = a.original_id
            WHERE a.trashed_at IS NULL
              AND o.media_type = ANY($1)
              AND (a.created_at > $2 OR (a.created_at = $2 AND a.id > $3))
            ORDER BY a.created_at ASC, a.id ASC
            LIMIT $4
